title: Add real SQL data management and improve task operations
requirements: Expose authenticated, bounded, read-only SQL schema and query projections backed by the running SQLite database.
Reject writes, multiple statements, unsafe identifiers and out-of-range limits without mutating the database.
Connect the original WebUI to real database and schedule endpoints while preserving its visual shell and clear empty/error states.
Apply the Tasteful UI principles of product fit, information hierarchy, restraint and real-data verification to the added workbench surfaces.
